meta.selection: Union of eBird species records in DE, NL and GB, including historical rarities, plus the retained original German catalogue. Occurrence records are not breeding or establishment status. Taxonomy is pinned to v2025; excluded source taxa are documented in catalog-review.json.
meta.validation: Arten-IDs, englische und wissenschaftliche Namen gegen die offizielle v2025-4 CSV geprüft; deutsche Namen gegen die Namensmatrix von 2025. Eingabecodes gegen die offizielle Codetabelle vom 27. Oktober 2026 mit dokumentierter Taxonomie-Ausnahme geprüft.

codes.policy: Official scientific codes first. Within scientific and other codes separately, prefer fewest matching species worldwide, then banding codes, then alphabetical order. All candidates are accepted. Scientific code names follow their source workbook; catalogue names remain pinned to v2025.

exceptions.spofly1: Retained v2025 species concept; v2026 reclassifies this ID as a slash (Muscicapa striata/tyrrhenica). Codes remain from the official 2025 workbook pending a taxonomy migration.
